title: Podesta staffer mentions 'the UFO project'
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Podesta staffer mentions 'the UFO project', about 2015 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Center for American Progress, Washington DC

tellings.quote: And at one point, there's an individual mentioned and one of the staffers said, "Uh John, maybe we should consider this individual for the UFO project."
